defaultPrompt: Create an official THOX paper from this research using Research Studio and the standard author profiles.
Continue this THOX Research Studio project from its latest private checkpoint and resolve outstanding evidence gaps.
Review recent primary literature, run authorized experiments and prepare a THOX paper with independent validation.
interface.longDescription: Automatically use THOX Research Studio workflows for relevant research and publication requests without requiring a slash command. Reuse available connected Studio tools, preserve private project checkpoints across sessions, and generate evidence-backed THOX papers with the shared Tommy Xaypanya and Craig Ross author profile. Includes recent-literature, engineering, review and arXiv-preflight workflows. Remote Studio tools and account authentication must be connected and verified separately; no background service or automatic publication is installed.

name: thox-research-paper
description: Automatically route THOX research, official papers, literature reviews and resumed projects through THOX Research Studio workflows, shared author profiles and evidence validation.
